content: Terminals and IBus: wezterm has native use_ime config option (IME processes keyboard input) but known IBus issues on KDE/Wayland (issue 5125, previously worked in kitty); kitty needs GLFW_IM_MODULE=ibus env var since it uses GLFW. Terminals are the known weak spot for IBus preedit/commit_text; established fallback is clipboard round-trip: wl-copy/wl-paste on Wayland (exactly what WaylandSwitcher uses for selection correction) plus paste-key synthesis. Confirms spec Q3 framing: hotkeys still detected, insertion mechanism differs.
